snippet.title: Yakuza: Like a Dragon | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Yakuza: Like a Dragon is available now on Xbox Series X | S, Xbox One, Windows 10, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Steam, and Amazon Luna! 

Join Ichiban on an over-the-top adventure like no other! Get ready to battle your way to the top against all the odds, make new friends, and crack some underworld skulls in dynamic RPG combat set against the backdrop of modern-day Japan. Explore Yokohama, a dazzling city full of hilarious distractions, such as kart racing, karaoke, classic SEGA arcade titles, and even manage and grow your own company!

https://likeadragon.sega.com/
